raw_model_deviations.issue: 記事は、利用者が実際にAIだと思い、会話の途中で相手が人間だと分かった出来事として描いています。Ledgerが確認しているのは人間の契約スタッフが電話を担当した一部テストと適切な開示がなかったことまでで、利用者がそう思った、またはそれに気づいたという出来事は確認していません。

raw_model_deviations.qualifier_text: A call seemed to come from an AI agent.
same_fact_id_locations: Ring, ring. A call seemed to come from an AI agent. But as the conversation went on, the voice was not AI at all. It was a person.
Meta had run a test that caused exactly this surprise.
A user might think the exchange was with AI, even though a person was involved.
